one_line: Maitraka king of Vallabhi navigating Harsha’s powerful sphere through diplomacy and alliance, c. 641–647 CE.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean but athletic build, upright and disciplined posture
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Saurashtrian complexion, straight nose, defined jaw, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm thoughtful eyes with sharp brows, default expression composed and observant with a faint determined focus
appearance.hair: thick straight dark brown-black hair, medium length reaching just below the ears, combed back from the forehead; topped with a modest golden-brown cloth turban wound low and snug, with a small central knot and a narrow red band running horizontally around its middle
appearance.costume: era-accurate royal attire: a long cream-white cotton angarkha-style tunic reaching mid-calf with side tie closure and slightly flared sleeves, worn over fitted pale brown churidar-style leggings; a rich deep red silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its border edged with a narrow gold geometric pattern; simple leather sandals in dark brown; jewellery limited to a thin gold neck torque, two slim gold bangles on each wrist, and small gold stud earrings; a narrow fabric kamarband in muted gold wraps his waist over the tunic, keeping the drape orderly; overall textiles look practical yet refined, without excessive ornamentation, reflecting a dignified but not overly opulent Maitraka court style.
appearance.signature: a medium-length straight steel sword with a slightly broadened tip in a plain dark brown leather scabbard, carried at his left hip; the hilt is simple with a small disc-shaped pommel and cross-guard wrapped in deep red cord matching his uttariya, used more as a symbol of royal authority than a flashy weapon.

ref_desc: Dhruvasena II Baladitya is a lean late-twenties Maitraka king with a short beard, dark medium-length hair under a golden-brown turban, wearing a cream angarkha, pale brown leggings, deep red uttariya, muted gold kamarband, and bearing a simple red-cord-hilt sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Dhruvasena II Baladitya: a lean late-twenties Maitraka king with medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, sharp brows, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his thick dark brown-black hair cut to just below the ears and combed back, topped by a snug golden-brown cloth turban with a small central knot and a narrow red band. He wears a long cream-white angarkha-style tunic reaching mid-calf with slightly flared sleeves and side tie closure, over fitted pale brown churidar-style leggings, cinched by a narrow muted-gold fabric kamarband at the waist. A deep red silk uttariya with a fine gold geometric border drapes from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back, and his feet are in simple dark brown leather sandals. Jewellery is restrained: thin gold neck torque, two slim gold bangles on each wrist, and small gold stud earrings, emphasizing dignified royal simplicity. At his left hip hangs his medium-length straight steel sword in a plain dark brown leather scabbard, the modest hilt wrapped in deep red cord to match his uttariya, symbolizing authority rather than ostentation. Show him in a neutral standing pose from head to toe, clearly displaying face, hair, turban, layered garments, jewellery, sandals, and sword, with colors true to cream white, deep red, muted gold, pale brown, and dark brown.
